requirements.summary: Retry deployment of the current application state without making any code changes
acceptanceCriteria: All existing features remain functional after deployment
Frontend assets deploy and are accessible

file_operations.description: Verify the React Query client and Home page rendering configuration remains intact for successful deployment
Verify the application entry point with React Query and Internet Identity provider setup is correctly configured for deployment
Verify the Home page component composition (Header, Hero, About, ContactForm, Footer) is properly structured for deployment
Verify the backend actor initialization logic and authentication flow are correct for deployment
Verify the Internet Identity authentication context and AuthClient configuration are properly set up for deployment
Verify the HTML entry point references to main.tsx are correct for build and deployment
Verify the Hero component correctly references the generated hero-bg.dim_1920x1080.png asset at frontend/public/assets/generated/hero-bg.dim_1920x1080.png for deployment
Verify the Header component correctly references the generated logo.dim_200x200.png asset at frontend/public/assets/generated/logo.dim_200x200.png for deployment
